    X = inputs['initial_value']
    steps = inputs['steps']
    shift1 = inputs['shift1']
    shift2 = inputs['shift2']
    shift3 = inputs['shift3']
    
    mask_32bit = (1 << 32) - 1

        X ^= (X << shift1) & mask_32bit
        X ^= (X >> shift2)
        X ^= (X << shift3) & mask_32bit
        X &= mask_32bit
    
    return float(X)
